blocks.html: Our providers are trained to handle all your school and sports physical needs.  All 3 of our locations accept walk-ins for these types of physicals. Our staff are familiar with many of the forms that schools in the area require and can also administer many of the required immunizations.

It is important to have an annual physical for your child to help evaluate any issues your growing child could be dealing with. School physicals include a vision check and can also help identify any other physical development issues.

blocks.text: What Happens During a School or Sports Physical?

blocks.html: School physicals will vary based on the school’s requirements and on the child’s age, but typically the following will be checked:

items: Height, weight, blood pressure, pulse, and BMI
Heart, lungs, lymph nodes, abdomen, skin, eyes, ears, nose and throat

blocks.html: It would be helpful for you to bring a copy of your child’s immunization records and a list of any medications your child takes including any over the counter medications. It is also important to call ahead if your child requires an immunization to ensure that we have the immunization in stock.
